name: hn-whos-hiring-parser
title: HN Who's Hiring Scraper: Hacker News Jobs Parsed
description: Turn Hacker News "Ask HN: Who is hiring?" threads into clean job rows: company, roles, location, remote/onsite/hybrid, salary range, visa sponsorship, tech stack, apply link and contact email. Filters, monitor mode, and the "Who wants to be hired?" thread too.
